note: Round 16 (2026-10-31): the operator, 2026-10-30: "need a different sound for artifact creatures and colorless creatures." Two new voices, the generic layer a creature resolves with: g.creature.artifact for an artifact creature whatever its colours (C|artifact-creature's clank plays on top), g.creature.colourless for a colourless creature that is not an artifact, an Eldrazi (C|creature on top). Both fall back to g.creature, whose keepers are one short low grunt, so these are as short: one sound of the creature itself, not a landing (the thud follows).
suffix: Fantasy card game sound effect, one single hit, dry, close-mic, no reverb, no echo, short clean ending. High-quality, stereo, 44.1kHz.
negative: low quality, muffled, lo-fi, hiss, clipping, distortion, music, melody, song, speech, words, singing, laser, beeping, chime, bell, gong, whoosh, explosion, long reverb, footsteps, crowd

g.creature.artifact.name: Artifact creature voice
prompts: A clockwork construct waking, a short servo whir rising and a low metallic hum
A brass automaton powering on, a hiss of steam and a deep mechanical groan
An iron golem stirring, a creak of heavy metal joints and a grinding gear
A small mechanical creature chirping, a quick ratchet click and a tiny motor spin
A steel war machine coming alive, a deep engine thrum and a pneumatic hiss

g.creature.colourless.name: Colourless creature voice
prompts: An alien void creature's short low warbling drone, eerie and otherworldly
A tentacled horror from beyond, a wet gurgling chitter and a deep resonant throb
An ancient eldritch being, a short hollow moan like wind through a hollow shell
A cosmic abomination stirring, a low pulsing hum and a strange clicking rattle
A thing from the void emerging, a deep reverse-swelling groan and a wet crackle
